description: Construction of Indoor Stadium in Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the promotion of sports activities and the development of sports infrastructure in the Northern Province, which is recovering from long standing social conflicts and challenges as a very important requirement. For this purpose, it has been proposed to construct an indoor stadium in the Jaffna District with the aim of developing indoor sports such as table tennis, tennis, badminton, netball and chess in schools and sports clubs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports for the construction of the Jaffna Indoor Stadium with relevant facilities at an estimated cost of Rs.170 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
